title: •Obi-Wan’s Apparition
caption: •Obi-Wan’s Apparition (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. May place your just lost Jedi out of play. May use X Force to add X to a just drawn weapon or battle destiny, where X = number of your Jedi out of play.
lore: “Luminous beings are we, not this crude matter.” The inner consciousness of a Jedi can transcend even death.
